_comment: Widgets that plasma-manager cannot reliably write and that plasma-fix-missing-panel-widgets.sh (see plasma.nix) must repair on every activation. Root cause: plasma-manager batches ALL panel addWidget() calls -- across every panel -- into ONE evaluateScript D-Bus call, and plasmashell silently drops repeated addWidget() calls for the same custom (KPackage) plugin id past the second one in a single script. Confirmed empirically on 2026-08-07: with left/right/guard declared on the top panel and proctable on the bottom, the generated desktop_script_panels.js contained all four calls with distinct mode values, yet only 'left' and 'right' reached plasma-org.kde.plasma.desktop-appletsrc. Adding 'guard' via a separate, standalone evaluateScript call made it land -- which is what proves the limit is per-SCRIPT, not per-panel, and not a repo-side config error (top-panel.json/bottom-panel.json/*.nix are provably correct). The two org.kde.plasma.systemtray instances on the bottom panel survive the same batching because built-in C++-registered plugins skip the per-addWidget KPackage metadata resolution that custom plasmoids go through. Each entry below is repaired by its OWN separate D-Bus call -- one call per widget is the entire point, since batching is what loses them. Structured as a list so a future dropped widget is a data edit here, not a code change in the .sh.

widgets._comment: The process table. 4th com.diegonmarcos.watchdog addWidget() in the batched script even though it is the FIRST on the bottom panel -- the per-script (not per-panel) nature of the drop is exactly why it needs an entry here.
